title: Unit Event — Unsteady, Still Steady Step

meta.Outline: Leo/need is increasingly in the public eye, appearing in interviews and magazine features. Just as they start preparing for their first solo show since debuting, they get an unexpected offer from Mr. Shindo.

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're on this page, Hona!
You look so focused and cool.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's from one of our performances.
Oh, there's even an introductory blurb...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “The leader of one of the bands that everyone's been talking about lately, Leo/need. Her bandmates trust her deeply...”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-That's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? I think it's perfect.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You and Saki are way too excited about this, Ichika. I mean, this isn't the first time we've appeared in a magazine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
This one feels special!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because it's Leo/need's first time on the cover!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've had small sections and short interviews before, but being on the cover does make this feel special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Speaking of which... Ichika, didn't you buy two copies?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I did. One to read at home, and one to preserve.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Preserve? You don't normally do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's because this one also has a special VIRTUAL SINGER section.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was just so happy that I got to appear in the same magazine as Miku...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, that makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Speaking of Miku...
They had some information on the Fan Festival, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, you performed in that way back when!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I won't be in it this year, but I still plan on going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You sure keep busy when it comes to these things, Ichika. Don't you also have a Miku concert lined up soon?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's right.
It's not as big as the Fan Festival, but I'm really excited about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, there's the bell...
We should probably start heading back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, see you all later.
We're heading over to the office after school, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Mr. Shindo said that he has something very important to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What if it's about our next festival?
Or another cover shoot!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're not going to get another cover offer just like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, you never know!
After all, we're “one of the bands that everyone's been talking about”♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I get it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know what he's going to tell us, but I hope it's good news.
A few hours later
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, Mr. Shindo, did you just say...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I understand why you're all surprised.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, allow me to repeat what I just said.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your solo show is set to go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A solo show...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
That's right.
It's actually been in the works for quite a while now...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But the venue we've been in talks with finally has an opening. Now we can say for sure that you'll be playing there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, which venue?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: TONE BASE Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, haven't a lot of famous bands played there on tours?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. It isn't just famous amongst music lovers. It has high name recognition even with the wider public.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: If you include standing room only, it holds about 1,500 people. I'd say it's the perfect venue for your band right now.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You have about two months to prepare for it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I know it's a bit of a tight schedule.
However, putting on a successful show at TONE BASE will be a fantastic feather in your cap.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: We promise to give you all the support we can, so let's make sure it goes well.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(This is incredible...
On top of being on the cover of a magazine, we get to do a solo show...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Things are going to get very busy, but we need to do our best. This is our chance to have our music heard by even more people.)
A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Everyone got your drinks?
If so, let's get started☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Congrats on your upcoming solo show, Leo/need!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were wondering why you all asked us to come over to SEKAI all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Our surprise went off without a hitch!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm glad for you, Rin.
You were so insistent we should set up everything without them noticing, so we could surprise them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And then she was the one acting the most suspicious out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, that's not true!
I kept my cool as the resident member of the fun and games committee!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm gonna make today's party super fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, I'll lead things from here!
Sit back, relax and enjoy the show, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Our first act is...
A session by KAITO and Len!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, let's give our second shuffled instrument band a big round of applause! Thanks, Hona, Ichi, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-The keyboard was so difficult.
I really struggled to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too... You have to use both hands and both feet for the drums...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. On the other hand, it was fun to try out instruments that we're not used to playing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's no surprise you seemed totally fine, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! What if we did something like this as an interlude during our solo show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An interlude?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We could take a little break and have some fun by swapping instruments for a little bit!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we can't just swap instruments and put on a bad performance. We'll need to explain it to the audience first.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
And even if we do swap, we should probably limit ourselves to one quick part.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're all thinking so much about your show already.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, we're sorry...
We didn't mean to let it overshadow the party.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, don't worry about any of that!
This party's a success as long as you all have fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. True.
Also...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Your show's only two months away, after all.
It's important that you all start thinking about it now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I bet there's tons of stuff you have to talk about and figure out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There is. But we should be fine, since Honami was able to put a schedule together for us using an app. Here, take a look.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, this is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Setlist discussion meetings, practice times... You have everything down to the minute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, and it even includes our meetings with the staff and what we need to have ready for them. We were also surprised when we saw this for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It'll be our first solo show since going pro, so things might not go exactly as planned...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But we all want it to go well.
I hope this helps even just a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you have time set aside for a new song!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Since it's our first solo show and all, we figured it'd be nice to have a brand-new song to play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That should make it feel more special for us and the audience.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But producing a new song means a lot more work.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Please let us know if you need anything from us. We'll give you as much help as we can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna help a ton too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There is a lot for us to think about, but we'll just have to tackle each thing one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All to put on our best performance to date and play the most moving music we ever have.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They all sound so motivated.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It is our first solo show as pros, after all...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I also need to do everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (To ensure that our show succeeds!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (A message? Who from...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I just received a message from Mr. Shindo...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He said that there's a bit of an emergency, and that he needs us to meet with him at the office tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
An emergency...?
W-Wait, what if something happened to our show...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Given the timing, that feels very possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
He didn't tell me much...
But I feel like he would tell us directly over the phone if something did go wrong.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In any case, we'll just have to hear everything tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...you're right.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, then, let's get back to our party!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you still have more stuff planned?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course!
We're only about halfway through!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Next, we're gonna play a version of Old Maid that Len and I came up with...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still, what could've happened...?)
The next day
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're being asked to write a song...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: F-For, of all things...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival...?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
That's right.
As I thought, you seem familiar with it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes. I love Miku, so I go to watch every year...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Ah, I had a feeling.
In that case, I'll get right into it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: This song is going to be played on the main stage during the festival.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The main stage...?
That's not the one you were on when you went, right, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: N-No, it's not...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: For now, how about I start at the beginning?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
First, the Fan Festival has two stages.
The amateur stage where anyone is allowed to perform, and the main stage where the VIRTUAL SINGERs sing.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: On the main stage, they'll sing a wide variety of songs produced by various creators.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, I think I've seen streams of that...
The crowd always goes really wild.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The VIRTUAL SINGERs are very popular.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Normally, they only play songs on the main stage which have already become a hit.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, they also set aside a few slots each time for young creators that they'd like to feature.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Young creators that they'd like to feature...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You mean the fresh artist slots?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. You really know all about it, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Simply put, they give young creators a chance to show everyone their talents by shining the spotlight on them.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Three slots are set aside for up-and-coming new creators, and the songs they produce for the festival will be sung by the VIRTUAL SINGERs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, so what you wanted to tell us...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, Leo/need's name has been raised to fill one of those three slots.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's true, the VIRTUAL SINGER version of our debut song ended up becoming the bigger hit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...!
Which means Miku and the others helped give us this opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, this is a highly irregular request. I recommend you hear and understand the full circumstances before you decide whether to accept or not.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Irregular? How so?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: First, the schedule we were given regarding this is extremely tight.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The reason for that being, all three slots for this year had already been decided and the creators signed on quite some time ago.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Unfortunately... One of the creators ended up falling ill, and seemed unlikely to be able to complete their song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, they began looking for a replacement creator, and Leo/need was the one they landed upon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The deadline we were given is two months from now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Two months? But that's...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly when we'll be working on the new song for our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Of course, we aren't about to force you to accept this offer. The deadline's extremely tight, so I'm telling you this knowing full well that you'll likely decline. Still, it bore bringing up.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: We have been attempting to negotiate for even a small extension... But it seems that the situation is tight for the Festival organizers as well.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Given the last-minute nature of this request, in the event Leo/need declines, they're prepared to move forward with just two creators.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Which is why I asked you all to meet me today. To discuss this matter, among others.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, in other words...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We need to decide whether to produce a new song for our solo show, or for the Fan Festival...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But... Isn't there a way for us to do both?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, Ichi and I can both write music. If we each did one...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not so sure.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something tells me that people at both events are going to want to hear songs that we wrote together, Saki. It's Leo/need's music they want.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I haven't really written a Leo/need song all by myself. A song I wrote all on my own... That wouldn't be what Leo/need is right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, we have to choose just one.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Playing a brand-new song at your very first solo show as a professional band can be a huge boost for a band.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: By doing so, not only will you attract a lot of interest, you'll be giving your fans what they want to hear.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, producing a song for the Fan Festival offers equally significant merits.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He's right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The main stage is streamed online, and they promote everything on their official social media accounts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...
It's a big opportunity for us to reach more people with our music.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Of course, we on the management side can make that choice for you.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But I believe... You should decide what you want to do for yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: After all, this concerns the principles you want to follow as a band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The principles we want to follow...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I understand.
We'll talk it over together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we're going to need some time. Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Of course.
Under normal circumstances, I'd have you all take as much time as you need...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Unfortunately, due to this schedule, we can only wait a week at the very longest.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...
We'll make sure to reach a consensus by then.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I do apologize; I know this is a busy time for you all.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But do try to remember that no matter which choice you make, you don't stand to lose anything.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
So, it's okay to go with your heart.
Don't be afraid to pick the one you feel you should prioritize.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course.
Several dozen minutes later
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can only do a song for one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's not something we can just decide right away. We have to take a lot of things into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe it's best if we all gather our thoughts before we talk it over.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, why don't we call it a day here?
We can pick this discussion back up after practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try to reach a decision by then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Then, I'll see you all tomorrow...
The next day
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can't seem to reach a consensus...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ugh, this is so hard!
How are we supposed to choose between our solo show and the Fan Festival?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially since either would be beneficial for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's important to constantly try to bring in new fans, but it's just as crucial to keep your existing ones happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hey, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Just as a thought... If we set aside the benefit to the band, which would you all choose, just personally?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Personally...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case... I'm leaning towards the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Haha...
Part of it is that the Fan Festival means a lot to me, since I've watched it for so long...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I also think it's a really good opportunity for us to get our music out there to a lot of new people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But writing a song for the Fan Festival would mean that we can't do one for our solo show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah, I'm sorry!
I wasn't trying to argue!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just, it's our very first solo show as pros. I want to do everything we can for the people who have stuck with us this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I think I'd prefer to focus on the solo show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I had to pick one, yeah, I'd want to do the new song for the solo show too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't get too many chances to see people react to a brand-new song from up close, after all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean... I also totally understand how you two feel. I still can't make up my mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's really not an easy comparison to make.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which is why this is such a difficult choice...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But if we don't decide soon...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We're already behind schedule for our solo show as it is, and if we want to write a new song for either event, we need to start soon.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Normally, I'd want to spend more time thinking about this. But...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I took control of this decision?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I realized something as we spoke...
It seems that our own feelings matter just as much as the potential benefits to our band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I feel that I should take a further look at this decision from other perspectives.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To find out which is truly in Leo/need's best interest.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In Leo/need's best interest...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But if we all discuss every new piece of information, it's going to take a really long time to get anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I'd like to sift through and organize all the information available to us right now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, after that, I'll have us all meet back up to make our final decision.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But won't that be a ton of work for you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It'll be okay. While I do that, I'd like to leave our setlist and the effects we'll use to you three.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In the end... Just as Mr. Shindo said, this is a question of the principles we want to follow as a band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, while I do want us to be able to sit down and discuss until everyone is satisfied... I want to make our general direction clear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As the leader of Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: While you think about that, we'll continue preparing for our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Please let us know if you need our help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, I will.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's do our best in the end to reach a decision that makes us all happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I am a little worried about this, but I need to do my best here.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (To figure out what the best choice is for Leo/need.)
Evening
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Anyway, those are the results of the post-show surveys for one band which is signed to us.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <The survey results don't show much difference in satisfaction ratings between shows where a new song was played and where one wasn't.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Yes, but please keep in mind that these are the results for just one band.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (You can only gather so much information from social media, so I asked if there was any data from other bands he could share, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <There's only so much you can tell from the raw data alone.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <But to reach a decision everyone can agree on...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <To reach a decision I myself feel is correct, I want to learn as much as I possibly can.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Please let me know if you have further questions. I'll try to help as best I can.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Okay, I really appreciate it.
Thank you for your time.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Despite the data he so kindly shared with me, I still don't really know what the right choice is...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Our solo show or the Fan Festival...
I thought that things would become easier once I had a better idea of how the fans feel, but...)
<Hiya, Hona!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Rin? Oh, MEIKO's also with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good evening. What brings you two here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. We were wondering how the prep for your solo show was going! You're talking about staging and stuff tomorrow, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Plus, Mr. Shindo contacted you during the party, didn't he? We wanted to know what that was about.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is something wrong, Hona?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Was it bad news?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, no. It wasn't bad or anything.
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm a little lost.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I see. So you only have time to write a song for one...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm glad that our band is receiving so many offers, of course...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm struggling to make a decision on what to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, this is a tough one.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It is...
I'm not even sure whether I'm approaching the question in the right way in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I don't think you're doing anything wrong, Hona.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Of course it's important to learn and think about lots of stuff before making such a big decision!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <She's right...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Especially because this isn't simple one-to-one comparison, you should try to be as informed as possible about the numbers and kinds of people you want to reach.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As informed as possible...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's right...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If I'm still not sure, then I just have to keep doing what I can.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (To ensure that I don't regret it, whatever choice I make.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Because I'm still not sure...
I'm going to keep gathering information until I feel satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehe. You can do it, Hona!
We'll be rooting for you!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <And we're also always happy to help if you get stuck again.>
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, Mr. Shindo just sent me some additional survey results. Let's have a look...)

rows.Speaker: Survey Comments
rows.Line:
“It was my first time seeing them live, and I got to hear them play a new song. Literal dream come true.”
“I got so excited when they said they'd be playing a new song next!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's so nice to have access to people's honest opinions like this.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, there's more. Let's see...)
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Hona!
Let's start eating our lunches♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika has that committee meeting today, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they have things to discuss while they eat, she said.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
Also, what were you looking at just now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You looked really focused.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was reading some fan comments on shows where other bands performed new songs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What the benefits were, as well as the numbers... I'm starting to get a better understanding of it all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My goal is to learn how to see the things that you can't just based on data alone.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh. Is that why you asked me if you could talk to him today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What did you ask her?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I've been going around to all the live houses we've played at to talk to the staff.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Today, I'll be going over to the one Shiho works at to talk to the manager.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to ask about how audiences react to new songs, and what those people feel. I don't think I'll be able to make the right decision unless I know these things.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let me know if there's anything else I can do to help. I can probably get you in touch with the staff I know at other live houses.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you...!
A few hours later
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time out of your busy schedule to meet with me.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: No, it's great to see you again after so long. Congratulations on your upcoming solo show.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I hope you and your band play at our live house again in the future. Anyway, good luck with everything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. Thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
How the audience reacts to new songs during shows?
Well...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: This is pretty subjective, but I feel like the more passionate a fan is, the happier a new song makes 'em.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: After all, for a fan, there's nothing better than being the very first one to hear their newest song live.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (There's nothing better...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I think I know what he means.
Even before we went pro, the audience reacted well when we played new songs for them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But the numbers alone can't show you how people really feel.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (All of these different voices are giving me a much better picture of the kinds of people who will be most looking forward to our show.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I can't say the same for the Fan Festival...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I've taken a look at the websites and social media platforms where VIRTUAL SINGER fans like to gather... But there's so much I don't know, I still feel like I'm grasping at straws.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Where else can I find more information...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You sure keep busy when it comes to these things, Ichika. Don't you also have a Miku concert lined up soon?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Ichika said that she's going to see a Miku concert soon...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Maybe actually seeing the people attending the concert will help me get a better grasp on them.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll ask if I can go with her.)
Weekend
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I never expected I'd get to go to a Miku concert with you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for asking you so suddenly. 
You even helped me find a ticket on resale too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't mention it! I was happy to!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I am still a bit surprised.
Is there a song that you want to hear?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Not exactly...
I just want to know more.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Know more?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. You're always telling us all about how great Miku is, but I really don't know much about VIRTUAL SINGERs in general...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I want to know more about their fans, and how they think and what they feel from their music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, today's show should be perfect.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, it's going to be full of people who really love Miku!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...! I'm very much looking forward to it.
Concert Venue

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What an incredible atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I was a little overwhelmed, is all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've seen some streams of Miku concerts, so I knew that a lot of people would be in attendance, but even so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I know how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's easy to see online that she's popular, but it's hard not to be a bit stunned when you see all these people here in real life.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Exactly. I can even see people here who look like they came from overseas.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It really makes me happy knowing Miku has fans all around the world.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I can understand that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, the lights...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think it's starting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for coming today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I promise to sing with everything I have, so I hope you all really enjoy yourselves today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(...!
What a roar...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yes...! I can't believe she's singing this song first!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Miku! Look this way for us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It feels so different from watching it on a screen...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can feel the fans' passion and excitement so clearly...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I can hear you all loud and clear!
For this next song, let's sing the chorus together.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I love this song so much...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Me too! Every time I listen to it, it reminds me that I'm not alone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (These people don't just love Miku...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They genuinely love the music they hear through Miku too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(If Leo/need...
If Ichika and Saki wrote a song for them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I think they would understand and accept the feelings in their music.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I want to see that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The moment Leo/need's music touches their hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku really is the best...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika's having so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Of course she is...
Miku's always meant so much to her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case... I'm leaning towards the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Writing a song for the Fan Festival...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That would make Ichika so happy.)
After the concert

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it was. My heart's still racing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad you enjoyed yourself too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I did!
And...it really was amazing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What was?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I could feel how much everyone in attendance loves Miku...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Or rather, I think I understand now just how passionate they are about VIRTUAL SINGERs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I feel the same way every time I go to one of these.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you thinking about the new song?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been doing as much research as I can to figure out which event to choose, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad that you're thinking so much about us as the leader of our band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks to you, we're able to focus on the prep work for our show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it also doesn't really feel right for you to worry about this all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... Please don't try to shoulder it all on your own, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thank you, Ichika.
A few days later
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We're having that discussion tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Our solo show or the Fan Festival...
I'm fairly certain that I've left no stone unturned.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I understand how the audiences for both events will feel now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I still don't know...
I still haven't been able to choose.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I said that I'd decide which direction we'd be going in as a band.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika said that I shouldn't shoulder this all by myself, and this is something I'd like us all to agree on...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But if I go into the meeting without a choice made, my indecision might just make the others more lost. So...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to sort out my feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Survey Comments
rows.Line:
“It was my first time seeing them live, and I got to hear them play a new song. Literal dream come true.”
“I got so excited when they said they'd be playing a new song next!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Playing a new song during our solo show will surely make our fans happy.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Plus, Saki and Shiho both cast their votes in favor of that.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I love this song so much...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Me too! Every time I listen to it, it reminds me that I'm not alone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I also want those who really love VIRTUAL SINGERs to hear our song...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm sure Ichika feels the same way.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is difficult...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I have to choose one or the other. So, I...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll choose...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Who's calling? Mr. Shindo...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Hello? How are you?>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<Good, thank you.
I'm sorry for calling you so late...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <But I have some urgent news to report.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Urgent news?>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Yes, the thing is...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <The request for Leo/need to produce a song for the Fan Festival has been rescinded.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <What...?>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<Oh, try not to worry.
It's not that we did anything wrong.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I just received word from their manager. It seems they've heard back from the creator who had fallen ill.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<...!
The creator who was originally asked to produce a song for them?>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Yes. It sounds as though they'll be able to proceed as planned with the original three songs.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <They were quite apologetic about it. I half-wondered if they might grovel for forgiveness over the phone.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I-I see...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<I'm glad that they're feeling better now.
It is little unfortunate that we've lost our offer, though...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<Yes, it is.
But we've received a new offer in return.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <A new offer?>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Their manager said that they'd love to have Leo/need write a new song for the fresh artist slots for the next Fan Festival. Partially as an apology for all the trouble.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <It's a way down the road, but I believe you should give serious thought to accepting.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <And since it's so far off, there shouldn't be any scheduling issues.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<U-Understood.
The others and I will need a bit of time to discuss it first.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<Of course.
There's no need to hurry now, so please take as much time as you all need.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<Still, I should also apologize...
I put quite a lot of stress on you for ultimately no reason.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <And this is a critical period with your first solo show coming up too.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Please don't! It isn't anyone's fault.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <And I'm glad that I heard this news before accepting their offer.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <That's very kind of you to say.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I intend to give you all the support you need to focus on preparing for your upcoming show, new song included.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Did I just...?)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <In any case, I'd like you to let the other members know, please.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I'll contact the staff for your solo show and let them know we'll be proceeding with the additional song.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Ah...yes. I'll be sure to tell everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<Thank you.
Now, if you'll excuse me.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Just now, I...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I felt relieved...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's right...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I felt relieved...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was determined to think it through and reach a decision on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I knew I had to be firm and make a decision.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But the instant I realized I didn't have to anymore... I felt relieved.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's not acceptable...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I got lucky this time around.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I'm sure there will be times in the future when I'll be forced to make a call.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Times when there is no right answer, and it comes down to my judgment.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to learn to be more decisive.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So that I can guide us properly.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (As the leader of Leo/need...!)
